title: Australia closed its capital-investment visa stream and replaced it with an achievement-based route
body: Australia's former Business Innovation and Investment visa programme: including the investment-based subclass 188 and 132 streams, which offered a residence pathway primarily on the basis of committed capital, closed to new applications on 31 July 2024. It was replaced by the National Innovation Visa (subclass 858), an achievement-based route assessed on the applicant's track record of exceptional talent or investment success, not simply on holding a qualifying amount of capital. This is a substantive change in kind, not just a rebrand, an applicant or adviser working from older guidance describing the investment-based programme as still current is working from an outdated route.
